question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Prerogative
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Privilege**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Prerogative"** means a right or privilege exclusive to a particular individual or class. (विशेष अधिकार)

 
 
• **Example: **It is the manager's prerogative to make decisions regarding hiring new employees.
 
 
 
• **"Privilege"** refers to a special right, advantage, or immunity granted or available only to a particular person or group. (विशेषाधिकार)
 
 
• **Example: **He enjoys the privilege of free meals at the restaurant because he is a close friend of the owner.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Prerogative'** is **'Privilege'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Privilege**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bias **(पक्षपात): Inclination or prejudice for or against one person or group, especially in a way considered to be unfair.

 
 
• **Example:** The referee was accused of bias towards the home team.
 
 
 
• **Satisfaction **(संतोष): Fulfillment of one's wishes, expectations, or needs, or the pleasure derived from this.
 
 
• **Example: **She smiled with satisfaction after completing her project successfully.
 
 
 
• **Predisposition** (पूर्वाग्रह): A liability or tendency to suffer from a particular condition, hold a particular attitude, or act in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example:** Her predisposition to anxiety made her nervous about the upcoming exam.
